shorts.title: The CIA Really Built a Spy Cat 🐈 Case #10
shorts.description:
What if I told you the CIA wired a cat to spy on the Soviets? Project Acoustic Kitty: in the 1960s a CIA veterinary surgeon implanted a microphone in a cat's ear canal, a transmitter at the base of its skull and a wire in its fur. A 1967 memo said cats could be trained to move short distances but not used in a real foreign operation. Ex-officer Victor Marchetti's taxi story was disputed by ex-CIA official Robert Wallace in 2013.
